headline: FIA tightens the rear-wing transition limit for 2027
body: The FIA is reducing the maximum time for active rear wings to switch between straight and corner modes from 400 to 300 milliseconds in 2027. The tighter limit constrains future rotating-wing designs, while the current designs remain legal under the 2026 rules.

headline: Racing Bulls expects a 2027 driver decision in the coming weeks
body: Alan Permane says Racing Bulls will take more time before choosing its 2027 driver pairing. The team is weighing its current drivers, Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad, alongside Formula 2 driver Nikola Tsolov, with a decision expected in the coming weeks.
